domainCards.name: Get Back Up
domainCards.text: When you take Severe damage, you can mark a Stress to reduce the severity by one threshold.

domainCards.name: Not Good Enough
domainCards.text: When you roll your damage dice, you can reroll any 1s or 2s.

domainCards.name: Reckless
domainCards.text: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on an attack.

domainCards.name: Scramble
domainCards.text: Once per rest, when a creature within Melee range would deal damage to you, you can avoid the attack and safely move out of Melee range of the enemy.

domainCards.name: Shadowbind
domainCards.text: Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries within Very Close range. Targets you succeed against are temporarily Restrained as their shadow binds them in place.

features.hope: Deadly Determination - Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Stress.
features.classAndSubclass:
**Class Features**
Marked for Death: On a successful weapon attack, you can mark a Stress to make the target Marked for Death. When you deal damage to a target you've Marked for Death, add a number of d4s equal to your tier to the damage roll.
You can have only one adversary Marked for Death at a time. This condition lasts until you take a rest, the current adversary Marked for Death is defeated, or the GM spends a number of Fear equal to your tier to clear it.
Get In & Get Out: Spend a Hope to ask the GM for a quick or inconspicuous way into or out of a place you can see. The next roll you make that acts on this information has advantage.

**Subclass: Executioners Guild**
Foundations
First Strike: The first time in a scene you succeed on an attack, you deal double damage.
Ambush: Your Marked for Death feature uses d6s instead of d4s.
features.heritage:
**Ancestry: Ribbet**
Amphibious: You can breathe and move naturally underwater.
Long Tongue: You can use your long tongue to grab onto things within Close range. **Mark a Stress** to use your tongue as a Finesse Close weapon that deals **d12** physical damage using your Proficiency.

**Community: Orderborne**
Dedicated: Record three sayings or values your upbringing instilled in you. Once per rest, when you describe how you're embodying one of these principles through your current action, you can roll a **d20** as your Hope Die.

Orderborne Sayings
Shoot first, shoot last
Always pay your tab
Porcupine's quills point backward
